acceptanceCriteria: A live GoogleTest run with a failing SetUpTestSuite yields a suite-infrastructure failure, not a count-mismatch refusal; the witness is retained.
The other tests' outcomes are unchanged; a genuine count mismatch is still refused.
body: Found by the V1-0593 native runner lane (beamfall/corvint#1001, head 20b4c6e0e, 2026-10-17, macOS 26 arm64). Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/native-2026-10-17/cases/. GoogleTest 1.18.0 reports a SetUpTestSuite failure as an unnamed testcase. The native adapter refuses the report with 'native suite count mismatch' (fail-closed incomplete), so a real suite setup failure is reported as a malformed report. Expected: a suite-level setup/teardown failure maps to FAILED INFRASTRUCTURE for the affected suite (as CMocka group setup does), with the selected tests not reported as passing.
title: GoogleTest SetUpTestSuite failure is refused as 'native suite count mismatch' instead of classified as suite infrastructure
